name: Hedge
summary: Ink sketch trimmed boxy green hedge segment, 1000 px wide, that tiles seamlessly; for gardens, parks and property edges.

params.name: y
params.note: ground line: the hedge sits on y

params.name: s
params.note: 1000 px wide and 350 px tall at s = 1; tiles horizontally at x offsets of 1000 * s with no seam

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror (the pattern is symmetric, so this only matters for lighting)
